items.headline: Will college football's top team stand up in Week 10?
items.description: With four weeks left in the regular season, Nos. 1 and 2 have already lost six times. What's in store for Week 10?

items.headline: North Carolina goes on the road to meet UConn
items.description: North Carolina (4-4) at UConn (4-4), Nov. 7 at 12 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Kemper Hodges' 4 TDs lead Air Force ground attack in 35-26 win over UConn
items.description: — Kemper Hodges rushed for 200 yards and four touchdowns as Air Force, once again, leaned on its ground game to hold off UConn 35-26 on Saturday.

items.headline: Air Force hosts UConn in Week 9
items.description: UConn (4-3) at Air Force (5-2), Oct. 31 at 3 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Kalieb Osborne, Shamar Porter guide UConn to 35-16 victory over UMass
items.description: — Kalieb Osborne threw two touchdown passes and ran for a score to lead Connecticut to a 35-16 victory over Massachusetts on Friday night.
